pro_course_detail.title: Conversation English
pro_course_detail.description: This lesson is designed for students at beginner to intermediate levels. Either the student or the teacher can choose a topic they want to discuss, such as their life, work, culture, current issues, or anything happening around the world. Exchanging ideas is an important part of learning, enhancing their confidence in speaking the English language and reducing fear of making mistakes. In this lesson, we can also incorporate grammar lessons and learn vocabulary based on the student's skills.

pro_course_detail.title: Callan Method
pro_course_detail.description:
I love British English, and in my last job, we used a teaching method called the Callan Method to help students improve their speaking skills. It's a fast and fun way to learn. With this method, you're speaking all the time and fully engaged. You learn at a natural speed, like native speakers do, which helps you pick up speaking quickly. You don't worry about translating or perfect grammar - it's more about speaking English naturally, like you did as a child learning your first language. We also cover British vocabulary, phrases, and expressions. If you're interested, I have great materials for you.

Please watch this video to know how it is done in class:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FSpjYOi6L3o&t=44s

Our goal here is not only to learn how to speak the Filipino language, but also to understand the vowels and consonants used in phrases, making it easier for you to pronounce words correctly.
Ang ating layunin sa pag-aaral ng wikang Filipino ay hindi lamang naka sentro sa kung paano matuto sa pagsalita gamit ng wikang ito, sapagkat layunin din natin na pag-aralan ang Patinig at Katinig sa Filipino, upang matulungan ka na mapabilis ang iyong pag bigkas ng mga pangungusap sa wikang Filipino.

pro_course_detail.title: Filipino Lesson 2: Learn Filipino grammar and its usage which can be use in a conversation.
pro_course_detail.description:
Our goal here is to learn Filipino grammar and how to properly construct Filipino phrases, which is essential during a conversation.

Ang layunin sa talakayang ito, ay pag-aaralan natin ang Filipino grammar at paano bumuo ng mga wastong salita gamit ang wikang Filipino na magagamit sa mga talakayan.

pro_course_detail.title: Filipino Lesson 3: Learn how to read and understand the phrases written in Filipino (Tagalog).
pro_course_detail.description: Our goal here is to learn how to read Filipino (Tagalog) phrases, making it easier for you to understand Filipino words you may encounter in the future.

pro_course_detail.title: ENGLISH LESSON 1: Learn how to pronounce and construct basic English words and phrases used in daily conversation.
pro_course_detail.description: Our goal here is to learn how to speak English fluently and to properly pronounce commonly used English words in daily conversations.

course_info.trial_description: The student will have a speaking practice with the teacher starting from self-introduction to answering common conversational questions. Corrections and suggestions will be done in the process.

pro_course_detail.title: Free Talk
pro_course_detail.description: The teacher will give two different ways to do the free talk, The student can choose one depending on his/her goal. The student's grammar, pronunciation, and vocabulary will be guided; errors will be corrected and suggestions will be raised to improve the students' words and sentences. In each session, the student will also receive a copy of his/her record of corrections or feedback which will be discussed at the end part of the class.

pro_course_detail.title: Article Discussion
pro_course_detail.description: The student will receive an article to be used in the class beforehand so that he/she may read it in advance. The chosen text will be discussed during the lesson through answering questions and discussing words used in the text. Students' grammar, pronunciation, and words will be guided by the teacher through corrections.

pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation Enhancement (New)
pro_course_detail.description:
The student will learn correct pronunciation through these steps: 
(1-hour lesson)
1. Phonetics and Sounds (per set)
2. Listen and Repeat
3. Problematic Sounds
4. Mouth Positioning
5. Practice in Context
6. Intonation and Stress
7. Tongue Twisters
8. Feedback
Note: The 30-minute version of this lesson has the same steps but with reduced exercises.

pro_course_detail.title: Writing Practice (New)
pro_course_detail.description:
A writing task will be sent in advance, at least 24 hours before the scheduled class. The student must submit the output on the day of the class, at least one hour before the lesson time. Then, the student's output will be discussed during the lesson proper. The teacher will explain every correction and give useful suggestions and other inputs to improve the output. 
Possible writing tasks:
-Answering a subjective question 
-Free writing about a topic

30-minute class: 100-word essay
1-hour class: 200-word essay
